title: Blinding Lights makes history with five billion streams on Spotify
content: The Weeknd’s 2020 single ‘Blinding Lights’ has become the first track in Spotify history to amass five billion streams, a milestone announced by Spotify on August 31 2025. The Canadian artist, Abel Tesfaye, celebrated the achievement with his 78 million Instagram followers. The song, released in November 2019 as the second single from the album *After Hours*, spent four weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and was the first track to remain in the chart’s top 10 for an entire year. In 2021 it was named Billboard’s Greatest of All Time Hot 100 song, and it topped Billboard’s ‘Top Hot R&B/Hip‑Hop Songs of the 21st Century’ list covering 2000‑2024. When the track hit four billion streams in January 2024, The Weeknd said, ‘I’ll never stop being humbled by anything I create, making its way to millions of people, let alone billions. I’m so thankful this song makes people feel something that keeps them coming back.’ ‘Blinding Lights’ is now one of 28 songs by The Weeknd in Spotify’s Billions Club, the most for any artist, cementing his status as one of the decade’s most‑streamed musicians.

title: The Weeknd rompe un nuevo Record Guinness con 'Blinding Lights' ¿por qué razón? | Actualidad  | LOS40 México
content: The Weeknd has set a new Guinness World Record with his 2019 single "Blinding Lights," which has amassed 5 billion streams on Spotify, according to the article.  The track has continued to break records, having been the song with the most weeks in the Top 5 and Top 10 of the Billboard Hot 100 in 2021.  In 2023, Guinness named The Weeknd the world’s most popular artist after he became the first to exceed 100 million monthly listeners on Spotify.  The article notes that his albums are among the most streamed on the platform and that his singles dominate the most popular playlists and competitive charts for weeks.  "Blinding Lights" is described as a generational anthem that has reshaped pop music and the artist’s career, and the record confirms his status as one of the most influential artists of the 21st century.  The piece ends by questioning whether any other artist will soon break this record or if "Blinding Lights" will remain the Spotify queen for years to come.

title: Песня Blinding Lights установила исторический рекорд на Spotify, набрав 5 млрд прослушиваний
content: The Weeknd’s 2019 single ‘Blinding Lights’ became the first track on Spotify to hit 5 billion streams, according to the platform’s announcement on 31 August 2025. The Canadian artist, whose real name is Abel Tesfaye, reposted the news on his blog that has over 78 million followers. The song had already dominated the Billboard Hot 100, topping the chart for four weeks and staying in the top 10 for an entire year. In November 2021 it surpassed Chubby Cheek’s 1958 hit ‘The Twist’ in Billboard’s Greatest of All Time Hot 100 ranking and later entered the Billboard Top Hot R&B/Hip‑Hop Songs of the 21st Century chart. By January 2024 the track had reached 4 billion streams, a milestone the artist celebrated with the comment, ‘Я никогда не перестану смиряться с тем, что все, что я создаю, находит путь к миллионам людей, не говоря уже о миллиардах! Я очень благодарен, что эта песня заставляет людей чувствовать себя так, что они возвращаются, чтобы послушать ее снова’. According to Billboard, ‘Blinding Lights’ is one of 28 Weeknd songs in Spotify’s Billions Club, the most of any artist, yet it has received no Grammy nominations, though it has been recognized at the MTV Video Music Awards, iHeartRadio Music Awards and Billboard Music Awards.

title: The Weeknd's Blinding Lights becomes 1st track to cross 5 billion streams on Spotify
content: The Weeknd’s single ‘Blinding Lights’ has become the first track on Spotify to exceed five billion streams, according to the streaming platform’s announcement on August 31 2025. The song, released in November 2019 as part of the album *After Hours*, had previously crossed four billion streams in January 2024. It topped the Billboard Hot 100 for four consecutive weeks and remained in the top 10 for an entire year, a record it set in 2021 by surpassing Chubby Checker's *The Twist* on Billboard’s Greatest of All Time Hot 100 chart. The Weeknd, who has 28 songs in Spotify’s Billions Club—more than any other artist—shared his reaction, saying, ‘I’ll never stop being humbled by anything I create making its way to millions of people, let alone billions!’ The artist’s influence was further highlighted when he headlined Spotify’s first‑ever Billions Club: Live concert in December 2024.

title: The Weeknd Makes History As 'Blinding Lights' Tops 5 Billion Spotify Streams
content: The Weeknd’s single "Blinding Lights" has become the first track on Spotify to cross 4 billion streams and has recently topped the platform’s 5 billion‑stream milestone, according to a Spotify report in early 2024. Billboard had already ranked the song as the top entry on its Greatest of All Time Hot 100 chart in 2021, and it was placed No. 1 on Billboard’s Top Hot R&B/Hip‑Hop Songs of the 21st Century chart based on data from 2000‑2024.  Singer Abel Tesfaye told Billboard, 'I'll never stop being humbled by anything I create making its way to millions of people let alone billions! I'm so thankful this song makes people feel a way that they keep going back to listen.'  Tesfaye has 28 songs in Spotify’s Billions Club, the most of any performer.  He is reportedly negotiating a $1 billion financing package backed by his music rights, with a proposed structure of $500 million senior debt, $250 million junior debt and $250 million equity; if closed, it would rank among the largest music‑rights transactions.  Similar large catalog deals include Sony’s 2023 purchase of a 50 % stake in Michael Jackson’s catalog for at least $600 million, and recent deals by John Legend and Justin Bieber.  The Weeknd previously aimed to sell a stake in his rights for $1.3 billion, and about half of his publishing rights are owned by Chord Music Partners, a consortium that includes Universal Music Group NV and Dundee Partners.

title: The Weeknd makes history with 'Blinding Lights'
content: The Weeknd’s single ‘Blinding Lights’ has become the first song ever to reach five billion streams on Spotify, according to a Spotify announcement on August 31, 2025. The 35‑year‑old Canadian artist celebrated the milestone on Instagram, where he reposted Spotify’s post to his 78.4 million followers (Article). The track, released in late 2019, has already broken several records: it topped the Billboard Hot 100 for four weeks, became the longest‑running top‑10 song ever, and earlier in January 2024 was the first to hit four billion streams (Article). With the new milestone, The Weeknd now holds the record for the most songs in Spotify’s Billions Club, with a total of 28 songs (Article). He also performed at Spotify’s inaugural Billions Club: Live concert in December (Article). ‘Blinding Lights’ is not only The Weeknd’s first to reach five billion streams but the first song by any artist to do so in Spotify’s history (Article).

title: "Blinding Lights" de The Weeknd dépasse les 5 milliards de streams sur Spotify
content: The Weeknd’s single 'Blinding Lights', released in November 2019, became the first track in Spotify history to exceed 5 billion streams, according to a post by Spotify on August 31 2025. The Canadian artist now has 28 songs that have each surpassed 1 billion streams. 'Blinding Lights' has remained in the Billboard Hot 100 top 10 for over a year and was highlighted by a specialised magazine as one of the most significant R&B/hip‑hop songs of the 21st century. In 2021 the track was performed at the Super Bowl halftime show, and it has also gone viral on TikTok and appeared in advertisements and video games. By 2024 it had already crossed 4 billion streams, and the new record pushed it past 5 billion.

title: The Weeknd rielabora il brano "São Paulo" con la brasiliana Anitta - Ildenaro.it
content:
The Weeknd has released a fresh remix of his track 'São Paulo' featuring Brazilian star Anitta, now playing on radio as of 26 September 2025. The single is part of a bundle dropped 19 September that also contains three new versions of the same song taken from his sixth studio album 'Hurry Up Tomorrow'. The four new cuts are the 'Single' version, a shorter high‑impact edit; 'Live from São Paulo', recorded at a 2024 concert in the city that gives the song its name; an 'Instrumental' take with only the music; and an 'Acapella' version featuring only the vocals of both artists.

'São Paulo' is one of the most beloved tracks on 'Hurry Up Tomorrow', boasting nearly 0.5 billion streams on Spotify, more than 1 million weekly streams on Amazon Music, and a steady rise in digital play. The song has also gone viral on TikTok, accumulating over 7 billion total views across all user videos. It remains a crowd‑pleaser at The Weeknd’s North American tour, where he is currently concluding performances. He will return in 2026 for the 'After Hours Til Dawn' world tour, which includes three dates at Milan’s San Siro stadium on 24‑26 July, headlined alongside Playboi Carti.

The album 'Hurry Up Tomorrow' debuted with 58 million Spotify streams in 2025, setting a new record for the artist’s best debut on the platform. It also topped the Billboard 200, becoming The Weeknd’s biggest debut ever on that chart, and reached the top of the Top Album Sales, R&B/Hip‑Hop, and R&B Albums charts. In Italy, the album entered the FIMI charts at #2 for both albums and for the best‑selling CDs, vinyls, and music‑cassette releases of the week.

Following the album’s release, The Weeknd dropped official videos for 'Cry For Me', 'Open Heart', and 'Red Terror', and released a trailer for the film adaptation of 'Hurry Up Tomorrow', a psychological thriller starring Jenna Ortega and Barry Keoghan. The movie, written and directed by Trey Edward Schults for Lionsgate, premiered in Italian cinemas on 23‑25 June.

The Weeknd’s commercial achievements are staggering: in 2024 he became the first artist ever to have 27 songs with over 1 billion Spotify streams each, and his track 'Blinding Lights' became the first worldwide single to reach 5 billion streams on the platform. He also holds the record for the highest number of monthly listeners on Spotify, peaking at over 120 million. In Italy alone, he has earned 50 platinum and 21 gold discs, making him the most certified international male artist in the country for 2024.

Overall, the article presents a factual overview of the new remix, the album’s commercial performance, and The Weeknd’s record‑setting career milestones, citing specific streaming numbers, chart positions, and upcoming tour dates.

title: "ENDED NICKI AND TAYLOR"- Fans react after The Weeknd's Blinding Lights reaches #1 on the Billboard Top R&B/Hip-Hop Songs of the 21st Century chart
content: Billboard has ranked The Weeknd’s 2020 single ‘Blinding Lights’ No. 1 on its ‘Top Hot R&B/Hip‑Hop Songs of the 21st Century Chart’ dated Aug 28 2025, according to the article. The ranking was based on the weekly Hot R&B/Hip‑Hop Songs chart from 2000 to 2024. The song also holds the record for the most weeks in the top 10 on Billboard’s Hot R&B/Hip‑Hop Songs chart, with 59 weeks, a record noted in the article. Netizens reacted on X, with one user posting ‘ENDED NICKI AND TAYLOR.’ The article reports mixed reactions, some praising the song’s longevity and others questioning its genre placement. The Weeknd, real name Abel Tesfaye, said in a November 2021 interview that he was glad the song was released ten years into his career, adding, ‘I don’t think [the success of ‘Blinding Lights’] has hit me yet. I try not to dwell on it too much. I just count my blessings, and I’m just grateful.’ The article also notes that the track surpassed four billion streams on Spotify in January 2024, earned No. 1 on Billboard’s Top Hot 100 Songs of the 21st Century Chart in January 2025, and has over 961 million YouTube views. It further reports that the song received no Grammy nominations, prompting the artist to criticize the awards as ‘corrupt’ in an X post in November 2020. The Weeknd’s ‘After Hours Til Dawn’ tour, which began in 2022, has grossed $635.5 million, surpassing Beyoncé’s ‘Renaissance World Tour’ record of $579.8 million. The next show is scheduled for Aug 30 2025 at NRG Stadium in Houston.
